'''Dimas Ezequiel Morales''' (born 22 June 1994) is an Argentine professional [[Association football|footballer]] who plays as a [[left-back]].<ref name="Soccerway">{{cite news|title=Argentina - D. Morales|url=https://int.soccerway.com/players/dimas-morales/299947/|accessdate=13 February 2019|work=Soccerway}}</ref>

==Career==
[[San Lorenzo de Almagro|San Lorenzo]] were Morales' first club, though he soon joined [[Atlético de Rafaela]].<ref name="Los Andes">{{cite news|title=Refuerzo lateral|url=http://www.clublosandes.com/not-12660-refuerzo-lateral.html|accessdate=13 February 2019|work=Los Andes|date=2 June 2018|archive-date=7 April 2019|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190407023601/http://clublosandes.com/not-12660-refuerzo-lateral.html|url-status=usurped}}</ref> He made his senior bow in a [[Copa Argentina]] round of sixteen tie with [[San Lorenzo de Almagro|San Lorenzo]] in June 2013, appearing for the full ninety minutes of a 0–3 loss.<ref name="Soccerway"/> His [[Argentine Primera División|Primera División]] debut arrived on 8 August against [[Club Atlético Lanús|Lanús]], which was the second of twelve total appearances for the club.<ref name="Soccerway"/> In his time with Atlético de Rafaela, Morales was loaned to [[Club y Biblioteca Ramón Santamarina|Santamarina]] and [[Ferro Carril Oeste]]; he didn't feature competitively for Santamarina, though did participate six times for Ferro Carril Oeste.<ref name="Soccerway"/><ref name="FerroCarrilOeste">{{cite news|title=Dimas Morales el quinto en firmar|url=http://ferrocarriloeste.com.ar/index.php?noti=13518|accessdate=13 February 2019|work=FerroCarrilOeste|date=13 July 2016}}</ref> [[List of regional football leagues in Argentina|Regional]] team Club Atletico Nación signed Morales in 2017.<ref name="Los Andes"/><ref name="InfoRegión">{{cite news|title=Dimas Morales, el sexto refuerzo del Milrayitas|url=http://www.inforegion.com.ar/noticia/267834/dimas-morales-el-sexto-refuerzo-del-milrayitas|accessdate=13 February 2019|work=InfoRegión|date=2 June 2018}}</ref>

June 2018 saw Morales, coming off a stint with San Lorenzo Mar del Plata, join [[Club Atletico Los Andes|Los Andes]].<ref name="Soccerway"/><ref name="Los Andes"/><ref name="La Unión">{{cite news|title=Dimas Morales, nuevo refuerzo de Los Andes|url=https://launion.com.ar/dimas-morales-nuevo-refuerzo-de-los-andes/|accessdate=13 February 2019|work=La Unión|date=2 June 2018}}</ref> His first appearance came in a loss to [[Independiente Rivadavia]] on 25 August.<ref name="Soccerway"/> He was released in June 2020.<ref name="GLP1">{{cite news|title=Los Andes negocia con tres jugadores de los que quedaron libres|url=https://www.grupolaprovincia.com/deportes/los-andes-negocia-con-tres-jugadores-de-los-que-quedaron-libres-523492|accessdate=10 July 2020|work=Grupo la Provincia|date=4 July 2020|archive-date=5 July 2020|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200705194516/https://www.grupolaprovincia.com/deportes/los-andes-negocia-con-tres-jugadores-de-los-que-quedaron-libres-523492|url-status=dead}}</ref>

On 15 October 2020, Morales moved to Uruguayan club [[Sud América]].<ref>[https://versus.lanacion.com.py/versus/2020/10/15/sin-chances-en-san-lorenzo-va-al-futbol-de-uruguay/ Sin chances en San Lorenzo, va al fútbol de Uruguay], versus.lanacion.com.py, 15 October 2020</ref>
